Announcements

Course Description

In this seminar/proseminar, students read, present, and discuss cutting-edge research papers in computer architecture, with a focus on memory systems, hardware security, and reliability. Students learn how to critically analyze research papers, deliver technical presentations, and write reviews.

Grading

Grading is based on paper presentations, written reviews, and participation in discussions. Details will be announced in the first session.
